message: The other night, we had a little smoke alarm drama when I decided to try my hand at making dinner. Turns out, a bit of smoke can really bring the family together! We all ended up in the living room, chatting and laughing while I opened windows and let the fresh air in. After that, we made it a fun family night to practice our escape plan—just in case we ever need it. Who knew fire safety could turn into a cozy bonding moment? What’s your favorite way to turn a mishap into a memory?
